text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. Fitted white long-sleeve crewneck top with visible panel seams, charcoal gray fluffy fleece drawstring wide trousers, gray cable-knit midcalf winter boots with large side buttons.。仅服装与鞋袜；无可拆卸配饰。
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One standalone photorealistic wardrobe catalogue product photo. Pure white seamless background, neutral soft studio lighting, realistic fabric texture. Portrait 2:3, full objects uncropped with comfortable margins. NO people, skin, body parts, face, hair, visible mannequin, hangers, stand, scene, text, brand logos or watermark. Hollow invisible-mannequin presentation; see white background through sheer fabrics. Preserve the reference garment colors, silhouette, construction and fabric. Do not invent footwear when not visible. Reconstruct obscured seams conservatively. Reference image is design input only. Target ONLY image 15 position left. rNcM means row N, column M, counted left to right, top to bottom across the full image. Images 3 through 7 each have exactly two rows and four columns. Images 2 and 8 through 15 have two people side by side. Image 1 is a single outfit with accessories. Ignore all other outfits, text and objects. GARMENTS AND SHOWN FOOTWEAR ONLY: Fitted white long-sleeve crewneck top with visible panel seams, charcoal gray fluffy fleece drawstring wide trousers, gray cable-knit midcalf winter boots with large side buttons.. Remove ALL detachable accessories including 米白罗纹护耳针织帽，双辫绳与毛球. Keep integral garment fasteners, sewn bows and ties. No new items.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。参考图中的文字与品牌标志不作为商品身份依据。
